attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post.

semantics.note: The proposition correctly isolates the present-tense observation ('still can't reliably') from the surrounding forecast about next year.

contract.note: Reading 'AI' as contemporary LLMs/reasoning models and 'reliably' as consistent success across varied solvable puzzles is an ordinary plain reading. The Jan–Mar 9 2025 window is evaluator-chosen but reasonable for 'still'.

evidence.note: Apple failure study submitted June 2025. Its test dates are not tied to the target window, and later work disputes its river-crossing solvability.
July 2025 replication reporting strong river-crossing success on solvable instances. It is after the target period and uses different prompting.
May 2024 paper showing mixed success and failure on a modified puzzle, with older models before the target period.

reviews.rationale: No evaluation in the packet ties river-crossing performance of leading models to Jan–Mar 9 2025. The failure evidence (e1) and contrary evidence (e2, e3) come from other periods, use different methods, and point in different directions. The packet does not settle the observation for the target period.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own post.

semantics.note: Faithful. The 'best work' framing is kept, and the checkable core is the named Google co-scientist.

contract.note: Separating overarching research goals from generated hypotheses fits the ordinary meaning of 'choosing the research goals'. Scoring only the named example is fair.

evidence.note: Google's Feb 19 2025 launch post describes scientist-specified research goals as input and experts curating 15 research goals. It is a company disclosure, but it is the primary record of the system's own workflow, as the contract requires.

reviews.rationale: Google's launch documentation from the target period shows scientists supply the research goals, and the system generates hypotheses and plans within them. The packet has no counterevidence. Support covers the named example only, not every possible 'best work' system.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own post.

semantics.note: 'Marcus thinks...' states his belief rather than the predicted event, and 'likely' modality overstates the hedge. 'I think X will' expresses a definite expectation. The proposition should read: the DOGE world will use these predictions to justify science cuts. The contract makes this correction.

contract.note: Requiring an explicit, attributable justification that links predicted Nobel-level AI to science cuts is a fair reading of 'lean on... to justify'. With no deadline, the contract rightly makes contradiction unreachable.

evidence.note: May 2025 Kratsios remarks justify funding changes on efficiency grounds, not predicted Nobel-level AI. Labelled a secondary summary, but it is the primary official text.
July 2026 OSTP report links coming AI capability to institutional transformation, but it names no cuts justified by AI replacing top scientists.

reviews.rationale: The forecast has no deadline. The packet's closest candidate (e6) ties AI to transforming institutions, not to cuts justified by Nobel-level AI, so the early-resolution rule is not met. A different stated rationale (e5) does not contradict an open-ended forecast. The forecast stays open.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own post.

semantics.note: 'I don't doubt... will' is a high-confidence forecast and is scored. The proposition keeps the 2026–2027 build-vintage restriction and the future-laureate scope.

contract.note: Reading 2026–2027 as the build vintage, not the deadline for benefit, and 'future laureates' as people awarded after the post, is the ordinary reading. 'Valuable' as material assistance is fair.

evidence.note: June 2026 paper credits Claude models for help with a proof. That is material assistance, but Parisi was already a laureate, and the paper does not verify when the models were built.
Official 2021 Nobel record confirming Parisi's prize came before the post. It is labelled a company disclosure, but it is the official award record.

reviews.rationale: The eligible model cohort runs through the end of 2027, after the evaluation date. No conclusive event is shown: the one documented case involves an existing laureate. A forecast cannot be scored before its horizon or a qualifying event, so it remains unresolved.
